title: libanotis ugoensis var. alpicola
intro: Libanotis ugoensis var. alpicola, commonly known as the Ugo's mountain lovage, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Libanotis ugoensis var. alpicola include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as volatile oils and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
